items.t: Said that medical decisions and bodily autonomy of every woman in North Carolina should be in their own hands.
items.q: We believe that medical decisions and bodily autonomy of every woman in North Carolina should be in their hands — not Phil Berger's and not Tim Moore’s," said Democratic state Sen. Sydney Batch

items.t: Said lawmakers were acting to make it easier for people intent on causing mass carnage to buy a gun, a day after a school shooting in Nashville.
items.q: While six families woke up this morning in Nashville grieving the agonizing loss of their children and loved ones, we are here today to make it easier for people hell-bent on causing mass carnage to buy a gun," Batch said.
